「You'll need to improve your own playing skills first. Start by reading the 'Lecture Plates' carefully.」

861:t_113:10.en:

「All you players should read them at least once too. Well, then...」

861:t_114:7.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You use $$Ｚチップ$$s to develop the $$Ｚクリスタル$$. Its level gives your whole force various benefits.」

861:t_114:8.en:
$$ノノ$$

861:t_114:9.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...Well, leaving this albatross's ambitions aside, developing the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ apparently has another important purpose.」

861:t_114:10.en:
$$ラルク$$
「So you should develop it as early as possible. See you next time...」

861:t_115:5.en:

861:t_115:6.en:
